cost_charge_package_scope.name: cost_charge_package_scope
cost_charge_package_scope.value: ("purchase_cost_charges"."charge_type" = 'products' AND "purchase_cost_charges"."package_id" IS NULL AND "purchase_cost_charges"."value_state" IS NULL AND "purchase_cost_charges"."amount_cents" IS NULL) OR ("purchase_cost_charges"."charge_type" IN ('brazil_freight','customs') AND "purchase_cost_charges"."package_id" IS NOT NULL)

cost_charge_value_state.name: cost_charge_value_state
cost_charge_value_state.value: "purchase_cost_charges"."charge_type" = 'products' OR ("purchase_cost_charges"."value_state" = 'known' AND typeof("purchase_cost_charges"."amount_cents") = 'integer' AND "purchase_cost_charges"."amount_cents" BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000000000) OR ("purchase_cost_charges"."value_state" IN ('pending','no_charge') AND "purchase_cost_charges"."amount_cents" IS NULL)

cost_charge_fee.name: cost_charge_fee
cost_charge_fee.value: ("purchase_cost_charges"."fee_bps" IS NULL AND "purchase_cost_charges"."payment_method" IS NULL) OR (typeof("purchase_cost_charges"."fee_bps") = 'integer' AND "purchase_cost_charges"."fee_bps" BETWEEN 0 AND 10000 AND "purchase_cost_charges"."payment_method" IN ('pix','card'))

cost_charge_customs_fee.name: cost_charge_customs_fee
cost_charge_customs_fee.value: "purchase_cost_charges"."charge_type" != 'customs' OR ("purchase_cost_charges"."fee_bps" IS NULL AND "purchase_cost_charges"."payment_method" IS NULL)

cost_charge_paid.name: cost_charge_paid
cost_charge_paid.value: ("purchase_cost_charges"."payment_status" = 'pending' AND "purchase_cost_charges"."paid_at" IS NULL AND "purchase_cost_charges"."paid_by" IS NULL) OR ("purchase_cost_charges"."payment_status" = 'paid' AND "purchase_cost_charges"."paid_at" IS NOT NULL AND "purchase_cost_charges"."paid_by" IS NOT NULL)

cost_tracking_state.name: cost_tracking_state
cost_tracking_state.value: ("purchase_cost_trackings"."status" = 'open' AND "purchase_cost_trackings"."closed_at" IS NULL AND "purchase_cost_trackings"."closed_by" IS NULL) OR ("purchase_cost_trackings"."status" = 'closed' AND "purchase_cost_trackings"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "purchase_cost_trackings"."closed_by" IS NOT NULL)

cost_item_effective_price_state.name: cost_item_effective_price_state
cost_item_effective_price_state.value: ("purchase_item_costs"."effective_price_state" = 'known' AND typeof("purchase_item_costs"."effective_price_unit_cents") = 'integer' AND "purchase_item_costs"."effective_price_unit_cents" BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000000000) OR ("purchase_item_costs"."effective_price_state" IN ('pending','no_charge') AND "purchase_item_costs"."effective_price_unit_cents" IS NULL)

cost_item_china_freight_state.name: cost_item_china_freight_state
cost_item_china_freight_state.value: ("purchase_item_costs"."china_freight_state" = 'known' AND typeof("purchase_item_costs"."china_freight_unit_cents") = 'integer' AND "purchase_item_costs"."china_freight_unit_cents" BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000000000) OR ("purchase_item_costs"."china_freight_state" IN ('pending','no_charge') AND "purchase_item_costs"."china_freight_unit_cents" IS NULL)

item_participant_percentage.name: item_participant_percentage
item_participant_percentage.value: "purchase_item_participants"."percentage_bps" IS NULL OR (typeof("purchase_item_participants"."percentage_bps") = 'integer' AND "purchase_item_participants"."percentage_bps" BETWEEN 0 AND 10000)

item_participant_amount.name: item_participant_amount
item_participant_amount.value: "purchase_item_participants"."amount_cents" IS NULL OR (typeof("purchase_item_participants"."amount_cents") = 'integer' AND "purchase_item_participants"."amount_cents" BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000000000)

purchase_finalized_date.name: purchase_finalized_date
purchase_finalized_date.value: ("purchases"."status" = 'active' AND "purchases"."finalized_at" IS NULL) OR ("purchases"."status" = 'finalized' AND "purchases"."finalized_at" IS NOT NULL)
